course_name_original: Chaines logistiques et ERP - mise en pratique
course_name_en: Supply chains and ERP - practical application
prerequisites: EC0707SI0303 - PRODUCTION MANAGEMENT BY THE MRP METHOD
EC0907SI0303 - SUPPLY CHAINS AND ERP - BASICS

learning_outcomes.text: Have an understanding and mastery of supply chain management and the use of ERP software for various commercial processes such as maintenance, customer management, supplier selection, and the Sales Process.
Participate in the improvement of a logistics chain (analysis, diagnosis, actions, management of the improvement project).
Participate in an installation or optimization project of an integrated management software package (Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)).

syllabus_topics: Optimization of the use of an ERP
Practical work on ERP System Analysis Program Development (SAP)
Integration of functions: production of a configurable product with Module Project System (PS) for Project Management and Production Planning (PP) for production planning
Management of logistics partnerships: response to calls for tender, order processing process
bibliography: Petri Helo, Bening Mayanti, Ronal Bejarano, Christian Sundman, Sustainable supply chains – Managing environmental impact data on product platforms, International Journal of Production Economics, Volume 270, 2024, 109160, ISSN 0925-5273, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijpe.2024.109160.

Kendrik Yan Hong Lim, Le Van Dang, Chun-Hsien Chen, Incorporating supply and production digital twins to mitigate demand disruptions in multi-echelon networks, International Journal of Production Economics, Volume 273, 2024, 109258, ISSN 0925-5273, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijpe.2024.109258.

Dmitry Ivanov, Intelligent digital twin (iDT) for supply chain stress-testing, resilience, and viability, International Journal of Production Economics, Volume 263, 2023, 108938, ISSN 0925-5273, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijpe.2023.108938.

Dmitry Ivanov, Cash flow dynamics in the supply chain during and after disruptions, Transportation Research Part E: Logistics and Transportation Review, Volume 185, 2024, 103526, ISSN 1366-5545, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tre.2024.103526.

Ana Gessa, Amor Jiménez, Pilar Sancha, Exploring ERP systems adoption in challenging times. Insights of SMEs stories, Technological Forecasting and Social Change, Volume 195, 2023, 122795, ISSN [phone], https://doi.org/10.1016/j.techfore.2023.122795.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
